tools.name: check_message
tools.description: Paste or forward a suspicious message. Hunch reads only the words you give it, on one frozen engine (the same engine behind the Hunch extension and site, running on our server), and tells you in plain language what stands out and the smallest next step you can take. tools.name: check_official_channel
tools.description: Ask whether a phone number, domain, email, or app is a channel an organization publishes on its own site. Hunch answers only from a public-source list (facts taken from each organization's own pages, with a source link and date, not confirmed to Hunch): anything not on it is reported as 'not listed'

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_message, check_official_channel · Public sink: check_message, check_official_channel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_message, check_official_channel · Public sink: check_message, check_official_channel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
